name: io.github.ekelly95/cronometer-mcp
title: Cronometer
description: Your Cronometer diary, nutrition with honest coverage (missing is never zero), and safe writes.

environmentVariables.name: CRONOMETER_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Cronometer account email. Optional if `npx @ekelly95/cronometer-mcp setup` saved it.

environmentVariables.name: CRONOMETER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Cronometer password. Optional if setup saved it to the OS keyring.

environmentVariables.name: CRONOMETER_LIVE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to accept the risks of unofficial access when using environment credentials.

environmentVariables.name: CRONOMETER_TOTP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Base32 authenticator key, for accounts with two-factor sign-in.

environmentVariables.name: CRONOMETER_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: Diary timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to the saved setup, else this computer's.

environmentVariables.name: CRONOMETER_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to offer no tool that can change the account.
